title: Wire C SOS TX as dispatch 0x16
description: Implement the C SOS sender path so the canonical SOS alert CBOR is emitted in an authenticated L2 payload with LICHEN_L2_PAYLOAD_SOS (0x16), not as SCHC/CoAP. Add or update the focused C host test/vector to assert the first wire byte and preserve the canonical CBOR bytes.
close_reason: Implemented LICHEN_L2_DISPATCH_SOS (0x16), SOS payload classification, and bounds-checked CBOR-preserving wrapper in l2_payload.h; added independent sanitizer-backed standalone test for wire prefix, byte preservation, and invalid inputs. Delegated Kimi K3 correctness/security/edge reviews were attempted but all failed immediately due to insufficient OpenRouter credits; local three-perspective review found and fixed empty-body acceptance. Tests: cmake --build build_worker8 && ctest --test-dir build_worker8 --output-on-failure (1/1).
